rows.title: Service Overview
rows.description: Service-wide request, error and latency signals identified by the Phase 1 Instrumentation Plan; data requires runtime instrumentation.

panels.title: Request Rate
panels.description: Rate of handled operations per second across all dashboard categories sharing the same metric family.

panels.title: Error Ratio
panels.description: Share of operations ending in the fixed error status pattern (5xx or error) across all metric families.

panels.title: p50 Duration
panels.description: Median operation duration in seconds (histogram_quantile 0.50) across all metric families.

panels.title: p95 Duration
panels.description: 95th percentile operation duration in seconds across all metric families.

panels.title: p99 Duration
panels.description: 99th percentile operation duration in seconds across all metric families.

panels.title: In-Flight Operations
panels.description: Number of operations currently in flight across all gauge families.

panels.title: Top Failing Operations
panels.description: Error rate per operation across all metric families; the table is client-sorted to surface the highest failure rate.
